Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and Ms. Vedika Dwivedi, who has filed Vakalatnama on behalf of the complainant and perused the record.
The same is taken on record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.197 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Biswan, District Sitapur.

3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant on 31.01.2022 and on 23.04.2024, an information was given that the daughter had hanged herself to Mohd. Sarkar Ansari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko.

1 death.
The allegations were levelled against the entire matrimonial family that they had killed her to death for dowry.
The cause of death as per the postmortem report, is ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark, no other injury is visible on the body of the deceased.
The statement of the informant and the mother of the deceased have been recorded, wherein the allegation of demand dowry by the entire matrimonial family could not be satisfied.
4. It is argued by the Counsel for the applicant that the applicant is the husband and no specific role has been assigned to the applicant.
The applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 24.04.2024.

5. The Counsel for the complainant strongly opposes the bail prayer by arguing that certain material facts were concealed, insofar as, the death had occurred afternoon and the information was given to the family of the deceased in the evening.

She further argues that the victim had left her parental home and after reaching at matrimonial home, the act was committed, as such, considering the gravity of the offence, the bail application should be rejected.
6. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Mohd. Sarkar Ansari be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 10.7.2024 akverma  Mohd. Sarkar Ansari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko.
